Crop the middle height x width of every image.

Keeps the centre of each image (torchvision CenterCrop), in training, validation and test. The model's input shape becomes [height, width, C]. The crop must fit the image.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Preprocessing](../categories/preprocessing.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `CenterCrop` |
| Search words | image, crop, center |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Images [H, W, C] in [0, 1], after Resize |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Images [height, width, C] |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Output shape | Width | `width` | Integer | `224` | `>0` | The run | Crop width in pixels, at most the image width. Required. |
| Output shape | Height | `height` | Integer | `224` | `>0` | The run | Crop height in pixels, at most the image height. Required. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Center Crop is a training image transform: the image batcher runs it on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize 256 -> Center Crop 224 -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
Runs in training, validation and test. The model's input becomes [height, width, C].
```

## Tips

- Classic pipeline: Resize 256 -> Center Crop 224.
- Place between Resize and Normalize.
